notes.prefix: APPROVED COOLING-COMPONENT ALUMINIUM STOCK, 2026-10-27. Purchase 1 kg from market for aluminium, wrought alloy, GLO, per kg component, replacing aluminium in mixed metal scrap from Europe without Switzerland. The former scrap input did not establish a finished metal supply before forming; the generic wrought-alloy market is the adopted metal-stock proxy. Actual alloy grade and recycled fraction remain unverified; this does not claim 100 percent secondary aluminium or measured radiator/manifold alloy. Preserve the 1 kg stock quantity, component output, forming, freight, infrastructure and all other exchanges. Do not add a second remelting process, recovery credit, yield correction or cancellation of native processing stock/losses/uncertainty. Original technosphere and biosphere declarations both remain 3.9. This narrowly corrects the feed identity; other inherited thermal, forming and equipment assumptions are not certified. Historical source text follows unchanged.
